tools.name: textline_list_conversations
tools.description: List conversations (one per contact) in a department of the Textline shared inbox, with the contact and resolved status. Optional keyword search. GET /api/conversations.json.

tools.name: textline_get_conversation
tools.description: Retrieve one conversation and its posts (messages in and out, internal whispers, resolve/transfer events), newest page first. Page with page/page_size or with before_uuid/after_uuid (a post uuid). GET /api/conversation/{uuid}.json.

tools.name: textline_get_conversation_by_phone
tools.description: Retrieve the conversation with a phone number (in a department) and its posts (messages). GET /api/conversations.json?phone_number=….

tools.name: textline_list_customers
tools.description: List or search contacts (customers) in the Textline address book: name, phone, email, tags, notes, custom fields, consent and reachability. GET /api/customers.json.

tools.name: textline_get_customer
tools.description: Retrieve one contact (customer) from the address book by UUID. GET /api/customer/{uuid}.json.

tools.name: textline_get_customer_by_phone
tools.description: Retrieve one contact (customer) from the address book by phone number. GET /api/customers.json?phone_number=….

tools.name: textline_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the address book's custom fields (name, data type, UUID). Use the UUIDs with textline_update_customer. GET /api/address_book/custom_fields.json.

tools.name: textline_list_saved_searches
tools.description: List the address book's saved searches (contact segments) with name, description and UUID. GET /api/address_book/saved_searches.json.

tools.name: textline_get_organization
tools.description: Retrieve the organization (account) name, optionally with its departments and agents. GET /api/organization.json.

tools.name: textline_list_departments
tools.description: List the departments (groups / inbox phone lines) the token's agent can see: name, UUID, phone number, type (sms, facebook, smart_sms) and member agent UUIDs. GET /api/groups.json.

tools.name: textline_list_agents
tools.description: List the agents (users) in the organization: name, email, UUID, permission level, availability and department UUIDs. GET /api/organization.json?include_users=1.

tools.name: textline_get_agent
tools.description: Retrieve one agent (user) by UUID or email: name, permission level, availability (on_call) and departments. GET /api/users.json.

tools.name: textline_list_dispositions
tools.description: List the dispositions (resolution reasons) set up in the account, optionally for one department. Use a UUID with textline_resolve_conversation. GET /api/dispositions.json.

tools.name: textline_list_surveys
tools.description: List surveys (NPS, CSAT, custom) with their type and UUID. GET /api/surveys.json.

tools.name: textline_list_survey_responses
tools.description: List the responses to one survey (ratings, follow-up text, contact, tags). Default: the last 30 days. GET /api/survey/{uuid}/responses.json.

tools.name: textline_report_conversations
tools.description: Reporting API: list a department's conversations filtered by created/updated time, resolved, archived or blocked, with total_records. To get the next page pass the returned next.search_uuid, next.page and next.page_size exactly (the same filters are kept). Then use textline_report_posts per conversa

tools.name: textline_report_posts
tools.description: Reporting API: list all posts (messages, whispers) of one conversation with creator, thread, first-response flags, filtered by created time, with total_records. To get the next page pass the returned next.search_uuid, next.page and next.page_size exactly. GET /api/reporting/conversation/{uuid}/posts

tools.name: textline_send_message
tools.description: SENDS A REAL SMS/MMS to ONE contact from your Textline number — the customer receives it immediately and it cannot be unsent; it consumes message credits. Address it by conversation_uuid or by phone_number (+ optional department). Confirm the recipient and text with the user first. One recipient per

tools.name: textline_add_whisper
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal whisper (a note only your agents see, never sent to the customer) to a conversation, by conversation_uuid or phone_number. POST /api/conversation/{uuid}.json or POST /api/conversations.json with a whisper.

tools.name: textline_resolve_conversation
tools.description: WRITE: mark a conversation resolved (closed), optionally with a disposition from textline_list_dispositions. Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /api/conversation/{uuid}/resolve.json.

tools.name: textline_transfer_conversation
tools.description: WRITE: assign a conversation to another agent of the same department, by agent UUID or email (one of them). Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /api/conversation/{uuid}/transfer.json.

tools.name: textline_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact (customer) to the Textline address book. Sends nothing to the contact. POST /api/customers.json.

tools.name: textline_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: update a contact's name, email, notes, tags (add, remove or replace) or custom fields (by custom-field UUID from textline_list_custom_fields). Overwrites the fields you pass; sends nothing to the contact. PUT /api/customer/{uuid}.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: textline_list_conversations, textline_get_conversation, textline_get_conversation_by_phone, textline_list_customers, textline_list_departments, textline_list_agents, textline_get_agent, textline_report_posts · Private data: textline_list_conversations, textline_list_customers, textline_get_customer, textline_get_customer_by_phone, textline_list_saved_searches, textline_list_departments, textline_list_survey_responses, textline_send_message, textline_create_customer, textline_update_customer · Public sink: textline_get_conversation, textline_list_customers, textline_list_departments, textline_list_agents, textline_get_agent, textline_send_message, textline_add_whisper, textline_resolve_conversation, textline_transfer_conversation, textline_create_customer, textline_update_customer · Destructive: textline_update_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: textline_list_conversations, textline_get_conversation, textline_get_conversation_by_phone, textline_list_customers, textline_list_departments, textline_list_agents, textline_get_agent, textline_report_posts · Private data: textline_list_conversations, textline_list_customers, textline_get_customer, textline_get_customer_by_phone, textline_list_saved_searches, textline_list_departments, textline_list_survey_responses, textline_send_message, textline_create_customer, textline_update_customer · Public sink: textline_get_conversation, textline_list_customers, textline_list_departments, textline_list_agents, textline_get_agent, textline_send_message, textline_add_whisper, textline_resolve_conversation, textline_transfer_conversation, textline_create_customer, textline_update_customer · Destructive: textline_update_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
